figure.purpose: The four readiness numerals on a shared baseline. Mono at light weight: the largest type on screen is still data.

title.purpose: Ruled section heads (t-section). A hairline and a name, never a kicker above it.

body.purpose: Application default, Inter 13/20 with cv05/cv08/ss03. Prose capped at a 68ch measure.

data.purpose: Every algorithm, identifier, date, score, path and measurement. Ligatures off.

label.purpose: Field labels, column heads, chips, the rail's three-digit view addresses.

shadows.name: drawer
shadows.purpose: The finding drawer, which slides over the ranked queue while leaving it visible.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: The report preview sheet, which reads as paper on a desk.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for entrances and state transitions.

motion.name: dur-base
motion.purpose: Fades, drawer entrance, toggle knob travel.

motion.name: dur-slow
motion.purpose: Rise entrances, staggered at 38ms per child.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single amber action per view. Amber is the deadline signal, so it is also the thing that moves you toward the deadline.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; background: var(--c-amber, #f0a03c); color: var(--c-amber-ink, #120b03); border: 1px solid var(--c-amber, #f0a03c); border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-amber, #f0a03c); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: The workhorse control: a bed-step field with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; background: var(--c-bed-2, #16191f); color: var(--c-ink, #e9e6e0); border: 1px solid var(--c-rule, #23272f); border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-default:hover { background: var(--c-bed-3, #1c2028); border-color: var(--c-rule-strong, #333943); } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-amber, #f0a03c); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Borderless inline affordance used for 'open X' links, rail actions and dialog close buttons.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; background: transparent; color: var(--c-ink-dim, #aab0b9); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { color: var(--c-ink, #e9e6e0); background: var(--c-bed-2, #16191f); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-amber, #f0a03c); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Mono label above, hairline field below. Caret is amber in every text field.
components.html: Year a cryptographically relevant quantum computer is assumed
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; line-height: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 500; color: var(--c-ink-muted, #858b95); } .ds-field-input { height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--c-ink, #e9e6e0); background: var(--c-bed-0, #0c0e11); border: 1px solid var(--c-rule, #23272f); border-radius: 2px; caret-color: var(--c-amber, #f0a03c); transition: border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: var(--c-ink-faint, #767c86); } .ds-field-input:hover { border-color: var(--c-rule-strong, #333943); } .ds-field-input:focus { border-color: var(--c-amber-dim, #a8722c); } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-amber, #f0a03c); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-field-hint { margin: 0; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; color: var(--c-ink-muted, #858b95); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Outlined 20px tag. Colour lives in the border and the text; chips are never filled.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 0 6px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; background: transparent; color: var(--c-ink-dim, #aab0b9); border: 1px solid var(--c-rule, #23272f); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-chip-amber { color: var(--c-amber, #f0a03c); border-color: var(--c-amber-dim, #a8722c); }

components.name: Ruled Bed
components.description: The panel primitive of this world: a hairline-bounded bed with a ruled head. Not a card.
components.html:
WHAT TO MIGRATE FIRST

412 findings ranked, 63 unrankable
ALGORITHM
RSA-2048 / PKCS#1 v1.5
DATA LIFETIME
not supplied
components.css: .ds-bed { background: var(--c-bed-1, #101216); border: 1px solid var(--c-rule, #23272f); border-radius: 3px; padding: 12px 16px; } .ds-bed-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-rule, #23272f); padding-bottom: 8px; } .ds-bed-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--c-ink-dim, #aab0b9); } .ds-bed-meta { font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; color: var(--c-ink-muted, #858b95); } .ds-bed-body { margin: 0; } .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 11rem) 1fr; gap: 2px 16px; padding: 6px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-rule-faint, #171a20); } .ds-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-row-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; line-height: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 500; color: var(--c-ink-muted, #858b95); } .ds-row-value { margin: 0; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--c-ink, #e9e6e0); } .ds-unknown { color: var(--c-unknown, #a083cc); }

components.name: Severity Badge
components.description: The system's signature mark: a hatched square stroked in its severity colour, followed by the severity name. Pattern carries the meaning; colour is the second channel.
components.html: CRITICAL UNKNOWN
components.css: .ds-sev { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; white-space: nowrap; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-sev-critical { color: var(--c-critical, #ef5f63); } .ds-sev-unknown { color: var(--c-unknown, #a083cc); }

components.name: Navigation Rail Item
components.description: 56px icon-only rail. The active view is marked by an amber rule on the leading edge — the timeline's marker-horizon device — never a filled pill.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 56px; padding: 8px 0; background: var(--c-bed-0, #0c0e11); border-right: 1px solid var(--c-rule, #23272f); } .ds-rail-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 34px; color: var(--c-ink-faint, #767c86); transition: color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-rail-item:hover { color: var(--c-ink-dim, #aab0b9); background: var(--c-bed-2, #16191f); } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-amber, #f0a03c); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-rail-active { color: var(--c-ink, #e9e6e0); } .ds-rail-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; width: 2px; background: var(--c-amber, #f0a03c); }

components.name: Readiness Figure
components.description: A monumental mono numeral on a shared baseline, mono label above, hairline to its right. The figures are the structure, not a KPI row.
components.css: .ds-figs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-rule-faint, #171a20); } .ds-fig { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 4px; padding: 20px; text-align: left; background: transparent; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--c-rule-faint, #171a20); cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-fig:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-fig:hover { background: var(--c-bed-1, #101216); } .ds-fig:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-amber, #f0a03c); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-fig-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; line-height: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 500; color: var(--c-ink-muted, #858b95); } .ds-fig-value { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 300; font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 5.5vw, 5.25rem); line-height: 0.85; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--c-ink, #e9e6e0); } .ds-fig-unknown { color: var(--c-unknown, #a083cc); } .ds-fig-suffix { color: var(--c-ink-faint, #767c86); } .ds-fig-note { font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; color: var(--c-ink-muted, #858b95); }

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Settings switch. Amber wash and amber-dim border mark the on state; the knob travels over 220ms.
components.html: Reduce motionCollapses every entrance to an instant state change.
components.css: .ds-toggle-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 10px 0; } .ds-toggle-text { display: block; max-width: 68ch; } .ds-toggle-label { display: block; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: var(--c-ink, #e9e6e0); } .ds-toggle-desc { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: var(--c-ink-muted, #858b95); } .ds-toggle { position: relative; flex-shrink: 0; width: 36px; height: 20px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--c-bed-2, #16191f); border: 1px solid var(--c-rule, #23272f); cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-toggle-on { background: var(--c-amber-wash, rgba(240,160,60,0.09)); border-color: var(--c-amber-dim, #a8722c); } .ds-toggle-knob { position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--c-ink-muted, #858b95); transition: all 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-toggle-on .ds-toggle-knob { left: 19px; background: var(--c-amber, #f0a03c); } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-amber, #f0a03c); outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
SUNSET is drawn the way a borehole log is drawn. One ruled axis governs the whole surface, material is stacked in beds against it, and the interval the drill could not recover is drawn to scale with its own percentage rather than quietly omitted. That last device is why the world was chosen: a dashboard of KPI tiles over a donut has nowhere honest to put "we do not know," and this product's most important number is exactly that.

The surface is near-black graphite at rest with beds stepping up through four barely-separated greys, divided by 1px hairlines rather than by card edges. Density is deliberate and high — the interface scale bottoms out at 10px mono labels — because a log sheet is dense by nature and the operator is reading it on a workstation, beside a terminal, for a long stretch. Amber is the only warm signal in the field and it means one thing: a deadline, or the action that moves you toward one. Risk is carried by hatch pattern before colour, which is why the product needs no separate accessible mode.

Both themes are authored, not derived. The light theme is the same core log printed on buff log paper with ink-brown rules and a darker amber that still reads as amber; it is not an inversion of the dark theme, and its ink roles were re-measured against paper rather than reused. Print is a third authored surface: the browser's own print pipeline against a forced paper palette, so the exported PDF is the same markup the operator reviewed.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled beds and hairlines; no cards, no rounded panels floating on a field
Severity encoded by hatch pattern first, colour second, ordinal by density
Amber reserved for deadline signal and the single primary action per view
Tabular numerals everywhere; mono for every algorithm, identifier, date and score
Shallow, role-based radius (2px controls, 3px panels, 0 on analytical surfaces)
Two independently authored themes plus an authored print palette

rules.name: The One Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber is the deadline signal, and therefore the primary action. It appears at most once per view as a fill. Everything else that needs amber gets a rule, a border, an underline or the 9% wash.

rules.name: The Pattern-First Rule
rules.body: Severity is encoded by hatch pattern before colour. Pattern density is ordinal — CRITICAL densest (3px diagonal), HIGH (5px diagonal), MEDIUM (4px horizontal), LOW (5px dot), SAFE sparsest (8px stipple) — and UNKNOWN runs counter-diagonal at 9px so it can never be mistaken for material that was there. Because of this rule the product has no separate accessible mode; add the pattern, not a toggle.

rules.name: The Two Themes Rule
rules.body: Light is not an inversion. Every colour role is authored against its own ground and its contrast re-measured. Changing one theme's value never implies changing the other's.

rules.name: The Tabular Numeral Rule
rules.body: Every numeral in this product is data. font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums is set on body, input, button, select and textarea; a column of numbers never re-flows as it updates.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: A section is introduced by a hairline and a name. There is no kicker, no eyebrow, no supporting label stacked above a heading. Explanatory copy sits beside the head as a wrapping meta line, and it wraps rather than truncating — a sentence cut mid-word has stopped being information.

rules.name: The Visible Default Rule
rules.body: Every entrance animates from an already-visible default state. A failed or suppressed animation must never leave content hidden.

rules.name: The Offset-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows carry an offset and a blur. A zero-offset glow is not part of this world; if an element needs to register without leaving the plane, give it a rule or a bed step.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Panels are ruled beds separated by hairlines. Never cards. If a surface needs to be distinguished, change its bed step or close it with a rule; do not float it on a shadow with a big radius.

dos: Do encode severity with its hatch pattern first and its colour second, keeping density ordinal (CRITICAL densest through SAFE sparsest, UNKNOWN counter-diagonal and sparse).
Do reserve amber for deadline signal and the one primary action per view; use the 9% wash or a rule when amber must register without filling.
Do separate surfaces with 1px hairlines and bed steps (bed-0 to bed-3), and close every section with a rule.
Do keep radius role-based: 2px controls, 3px panels, 0 on anything analytical.
Do set every numeral tabular and every identifier, algorithm, date, score and path in JetBrains Mono with ligatures off.
Do read every colour from src/styles/tokens.css via its Tailwind alias, so a theme change stays a token swap.
Do author the light theme against paper on its own terms and re-measure its ink roles to 4.5:1.
Do start every entrance animation from an already-visible default, and honour both the OS reduced-motion preference and the in-product setting.
Do put the severity key on the surface where the patterns are used.
donts: Don't build panels as cards — no floating rounded surfaces on a field, no card grids where a ruled bed or a real table belongs.
Don't distinguish severity by colour alone, or add a parallel "accessible mode" instead of a pattern.
Don't use amber as a surface fill for anything but the single primary action, and never for a whole panel or row background.
Don't use a zero-offset halo or glow shadow; shadows carry offset and blur, and only on elements that leave the plane.
Don't stack a kicker or eyebrow above a section head; a hairline and a name is the whole head.
Don't use proportional numerals, ligatured mono, or a decorative display face — there is no display face in this system.
Don't derive the light theme by inverting the dark one, or reuse a dark-theme risk hue on paper.
Don't hardcode a hex value in a component; every colour has a token, and a component that bypasses it will not follow the theme or the print palette.
Don't remove or re-style the global focus ring per component.
